Proof of work

Finance & administrative work samples

Examples of the reconciliation, validation, and reporting work I do. Names, numbers, and company details are fictional or masked.

Expense reconciliation · Excel

Inadvertent Charge & Refund Reconciliation

I matched card charges that employees reported as personal or inadvertent against approved entries and refunds, tracked a match status on every line, and followed up on items that did not match.

  • Check each charge against its expense entry and paid date
  • Mark it matched or unmatched and note the run period
  • Follow up with employees and the card team on open items
Accounts payable · PO matching

Invoice Validation & PO Matching

Before an invoice moved forward, I compared its PO number and supplier with the purchase order in the system and flagged anything that did not line up. Real screen, details masked.

  • Confirm the PO number and supplier match the order
  • Check amounts, dates, and payment terms against the PO
  • Route exceptions to the buyer or approver with notes
